int_name: N BROAD ST & OLD YORK RD

result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing basic infrastructure for crossing. However, the wide multi-lane roadway lacks physical protection such as a median refuge or curb extensions, resulting in high exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four or more lanes of traffic without a median refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: A large bus and parked vehicles near the intersection can block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image near the bus stop and curb

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a commercial intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, a marked crosswalk, and traffic signals. However, the environment is characterized by wide crossing distances, faded pavement markings, and parked vehicles that may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk is significantly worn, reducing its visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the intersection corner may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image near the crosswalk

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with continental-style markings to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the intersection, improving sightlines.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide commercial corridor with a multi-lane roadway and a central concrete median serving as a pedestrian refuge. While high-visibility crosswalks and sidewalks are present, the environment is dominated by vehicle traffic and lacks green infrastructure or visible pedestrian-specific signals.

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk across the main thoroughfare

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbside parking lanes on both sides of the street

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines for all road users.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

result.summary: The intersection features a signalized crossing in a commercial district but lacks any visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. High volumes of vehicle traffic and sightline obstructions from parked cars create a high-risk environment for pedestrians despite the presence of sidewalks.

hazards.name: Missing crosswalk markings
hazards.description: No painted markings are visible at the intersection to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to crossing locations.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection of Broad St and Chew Ave

hazards.name: Sightline obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and large SUVs in the foreground block the view between pedestrians on the corner and approaching traffic.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians at the corners.

interventions.title: Pedestrian countdown signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.
